scope: Two synthetic scenarios; numerical agreement is not reproduction of Cheng author data or author settings.

tolerances.discrete_outputs: exact equality: scores, flags, ranks, factor arrays, counts and distinguishing/consensus classes

tolerance_rationale: Matching eps and normalization removes default-iteration differences. Tight matrix/eigen tolerances allow floating-point library variation; arithmetic tolerances allow small rotation error amplified by l/(1-l^2). Never expand tolerances after a failed run. The native default eps=1e-5 result is a separately labelled diagnostic, not an alternate passing gate.
source_observation: The inspected psych 2.5.6 archive forwards ... to stats::varimax, allowing normalize and eps. Do not infer this from moving master. qmethod::qzscores returns loa, flagged, zsc, zsc_n and f_char; qdc is a separate official step when using qzscores.
dependencies: R base/recommended packages are supplied by the pinned R runtime. Non-numerical import dependencies are installed from official CRAN and recorded with sessionInfo; they are not asserted to match the author environment. GPArotation is imported by psych but the declared lowercase varimax path calls stats::varimax.
